
  // (type string)
  public class Type_string {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_stringn : String
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_constructor_string
  public static func v_constructor_string(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_global()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.Type_string()
    return output
  }

  // v_create_string
  public static func v_create_string(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_constructor_string()
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_string(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_initialize_string
  public static func v_initialize_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_string,
      value)
    value.p_stringn = ""
  }

  // v_release_string
  public static func v_release_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    if value !== Vx_Core.e_string {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value.p_any)
    }
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.e_string
    return output
  }

  // v_reserve_string
  public static func v_reserve_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_any(
      value.p_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = value
    return output
  }

  // v_shutdown_string
  public static func v_shutdown_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) {
    value.p_stringn = ""
    Vx_Core.v_shutdown_any(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_release_global()
  }

  // v_startup_string
  public static func v_startup_string(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_string
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.e_string
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_string(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "string",
      "string",
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.v_varmap_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "stringn",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn)
      ])
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_create_generic()
    type_generic.p_copy_funcn = Vx_Core.a_copy_string
    type_generic.p_new_funcn = Vx_Core.a_new_string
    t_variable.type_generic = type_generic
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_string
  public static func v_cast_string(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.e_string
    if type_any.p_type === Vx_Core.t_string {
      output = unsafeBitCast(type_any.backref, to: Vx_Core.Type_string.self)
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_cast_string
  public static func a_cast_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_clone_string
  public static func v_clone_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_create_string()
    return output
  }

  // v_copy_string
  public static func v_copy_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.e_string
    return output
  }

  // a_copy_string
  public static func a_copy_string(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_cast_string(
      type_any)
    let copy_value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_copy_string(
      value,
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = copy_value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_new_string
  public static func v_new_string(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_copy_string(
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // a_new_string
  public static func a_new_string(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_new_string(
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // f_string
  public static func f_string(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_new_string(
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  public static let t_string : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_constructor_type()
  public static let e_string : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_constructor_string()
